## Episode Thesis

The episode covers the Riksbank's expected hike of the policy rate from 1.75% to 2%. Guest economist Susanne Spektor says all the arrows point to higher inflation, around 3.5-4% in 2027 as the tax effects fade, and expects further hikes in February and March. Swedish households and the economy are described as resilient, with upside risk to GDP forecasts. A closing AMF segment calls AI a dominant theme for global equity funds.
